products.name: Korg Kronos 88-Key Music Workstation
products.description: The pinnacle of synthesis, the Korg Kronos features 9 sound engines, solid-state internal drive, and a 8-inch color TouchView display.

products.name: Yamaha PSR-SX900 Arranger Workstation
products.description: The Yamaha PSR-SX900 is packed with a comprehensive suite of incredible voices and accompaniment styles, expansive connectivity, and a color touchscreen interface perfect for church worship, studio recording, and live stage performance.

products.name: Roland XPS-30 Expandable Synthesizer
products.description: The Roland XPS-30 builds on the legendary XPS-10, adding tons of modern upgrades like sample import via USB, intuitive sound modify sliders, eight phrase pads, and dedicated mic input with vocal effects.

products.name: Fender Player Stratocaster Electric Guitar
products.description: The inspiring sound of a Stratocaster is one of the foundations of Fender. Featuring classic bell-like high end, punchy mids and robust low end, combined with crystal-clear articulation, the Player Stratocaster is packed with authentic Fender feel.

specs.Pickups: Three Player Series Alnico 5 Strat Single-Coils

products.name: Ibanez GSR200 Soundgear 4-String Bass Guitar
products.description: The Ibanez GSR200 offers the famous Soundgear sleekness, comfort, tone, and playability at an entry-level price point. Features Phat II active bass boost for thunderous bottom end.

specs.Electronics: Phat II EQ Active Bass Boost

products.name: Pearl Export EXX 5-Piece Complete Drum Kit
products.description: The legends return. Pearl Export Series provides the sonic standard for worship centres, touring artists, and recording facilities with Reference-inspired shell composition and sturdy 830 hardware.

products.name: Roland TD-17KVX V-Drums Electronic Drum Kit
products.description: When you are serious about drumming, you need a kit to match your ambition. The TD-17 series lets your technique shine through, backed by training tools to push you further.

products.name: Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 (4th Gen) Audio Interface
products.description: The 4th Generation Scarlett 2i2 gives songwriters huge reasons to upgrade, with updated ultra-low-noise mic preamps, 120dB dynamic range converters, Auto Gain, Clip Safe, and redesigned Air mode.

specs.Included Software: Ableton Live Lite, Pro Tools Artist 3-month trial

products.name: Yamaha HS8 Powered Studio Monitor (Pair)
products.description: Nearfield reference monitors built on the philosophy of sonic purity. The white cone HS series delivers true, accurate sound reproduction without hype or coloring.

products.name: Shure BLX288/PG58 Dual Wireless Vocal System
products.description: The gold standard for church worship, conferences, and live performance. Includes BLX88 dual-channel receiver and two BLX2 handheld transmitters with PG58 microphone capsules.

specs.Range: Up to 300 ft (100 m) line of sight
specs.Battery Life: Up to 14 hours on 2 AA batteries

products.name: Yamaha DBR15 1000W 15-inch Powered Speaker
products.description: The DBR15 achieves best-in-class SPL of up to 132dB and delivers the lowest frequency in its lineup. Great for front-of-house sound for live performance, DJs, or church auditoriums.

products.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX4 2-Channel DJ Controller
products.description: The Pioneer DJ DDJ-FLX4 is a versatile 2-channel controller with a club-standard layout, compatible with both rekordbox and Serato DJ Lite. Features Smart Fader and Smart CFX.

specs.Compatibility: rekordbox, Serato DJ, djay for iOS/Android

products.name: Shure SM58-LC Cardioid Dynamic Vocal Mic
products.description: The legendary vocal microphone designed for professional vocal use in live performance, sound reinforcement, and studio recording. Highly effective spherical filter minimizes wind and breath pop noise.
